settings.promo.tmdb.title: Turn on TMDB
settings.promo.tmdb.text: Posters, plots, cast, ratings, trailers and suggestions; the same title merged across categories and providers. Free key from themoviedb.org, typed below.
settings.promo.trakt.title: Connect Trakt
settings.promo.trakt.text: History, "watched" and "continue watching" in sync between TV, PC and phone, and suggestions from your taste. Free account on trakt.tv.
settings.promo.opensubtitles.title: Turn on OpenSubtitles
settings.promo.opensubtitles.text: Subtitles in your language for movies and episodes, also when the file has none, with timing adjustment. Free key from opensubtitles.com.

diag.shareLogsText: Scan it with a phone: a page shows the newest {lines} lines of the log, to copy into a report. They go only from the TV to the phone, no server receives them.

categories.busy: Wait for the catalog update to finish.

settings.resetAllConfirm: Delete all data? Providers, catalogs, favourites, history, keys and settings will be erased and the app returns to its first-start state.

trakt.needKeys: Enter the Trakt Client ID and Client Secret

schedule.startingSoon: Coming up: {title} on {channel}, the channel starts in 10 seconds
schedule.exactMessage: To be alerted when a scheduled programme starts, allow "Alarms & reminders" for Xtream IPTV in the settings. Without it the alert may come late.
settings.dbUpdate: Rebuild the databases (no download from the provider)

settings.epgRemoveConfirm: Delete the downloaded TV guide? It is downloaded again at the next start or with the update button.

profiles.title: Profiles

align.badSpeed: The points do not agree (a speed that does not happen): do point {n} again.
align.badPoint: Point {n} does not agree with the others: do it again.
align.help: Choose a line of the subtitles with ← / → and press OK. Align the video to the line on screen with ← / → (OK plays them together) and when you are done press "Add point".
update.trialFailed: Version {version} did not start: the previous version is in use again. It is not downloaded again by itself (Settings › Check for updates tries it again).
startup.title: The app could not start
startup.text: Here is what went wrong and the log. A newer version may solve it: check for updates, or restart the app.
startup.qr: Scan to read the log on a phone
startup.available: Version {version} is available. Install it now?
startup.installFailed: The update could not be downloaded: {error}
sync.title: Sync devices
sync.hint: Keep several TVs the same: providers, settings, profiles, keys, Trakt, watch state, favourites, collections and pinned entries. Everything is encrypted on the TV with your password: the server cannot read it. Not synced: the parental PINs and the settings of each TV (text size, screensaver, buffer).
sync.passwordShort: The password needs at least {min} characters
sync.offline: The sync server could not be reached: try again later
sync.noAccount: No account with this username: create it in Settings › Sync devices on the TV already set up
sync.replaced: The data of the account is here: the app starts again
sync.created: Account created: the data of this TV is sent to it
sync.connected: Logged in: the data of this TV is sent to the account
sync.emptyAccount: Logged in: the account is still empty. Add a provider: it is sent to the account
sync.applied: {count} changes taken from the account: the app starts again
sync.removeTitle: Remove this TV from the sync
sync.removeMessage: This TV leaves the sync and the app is reset: all its data is deleted from this TV (it stays in the account). Continue?
sync.locked: Too many wrong passwords today: changes are not taken until tomorrow
sync.replaceTitle: Take the data of the account
sync.replaceMessage: The account holds {count} items. The synced data of this TV (providers, profiles, settings, favourites, watch state…) is replaced by the account's. Continue?
sync.fromAccountHint: Everything from a sync account another TV already set up (Settings › Sync devices there).
